analysis.aliased_action_rule: Retain clipped/aliased assignments in intention-to-treat estimates; report counts and do not claim effective action separation if actuator response fails.
analysis.covariance: peer-clustered CR1 sandwich with t reference on 63 degrees of freedom

endpoints.definition: pass-through pre-RTP encoded payload bytes per second in the complete 1.8-2.6 second post-ack window divided by pre-assignment sender BWE
endpoints.name: actual_payload_ratio

endpoints.definition: eligible source capture requests read back within 150 ms divided by all eligible requests in the acknowledged hold; missing and late readbacks are failures
endpoints.name: on_time_share

analysis.estimand: marginal proximal intention-to-treat effect of current assigned BWE ratio over histories generated by the registered SHA-256 pseudo-randomized hold assignments and the crossed scene/trace panel
analysis.missing_endpoint_rule: If any of the 384 assigned holds lacks a complete payload window or a nonzero eligible request denominator, retain all raw evidence and suppress the registered contrast family; no replacement peer or per-protocol rescue.
analysis.p_adjustment: Holm across all six two-sided endpoint-by-contrast tests

claim_limits: Factual native-stack development evidence on one cloud machine, one Chromium build, localhost TURN/TCP and one userspace queue mechanism.
The four authored capacity traces vary settings, not physical network families; propagation remains fixed at 25 ms.
Procedural scenes are not licensed video or representative natural content.

This assay estimates proximal pseudo-randomized assignments over observed histories; it does not estimate a learned policy, conditional action value, episode-level safety, calibration or whole-session QoE advantage.
No simulator counterfactual, hidden network simulator field, real-network observation, or controller promotion is permitted.

protocol_changes: shorter dedicated external raw output path
continuation.reason: Chromium could not create its singleton Unix socket beneath the overlong nested TMPDIR; failure occurred before DevTools attached or the probe page ran.

continuation_from_inventory_failure.change: Keep inventory and analysis gates fixed; move Chromium TMPDIR to a short private /tmp directory created for the full capture and removed before raw inventory.

design.assignment_implementation: native_actuator_instrument_v1 SHA-256 arm mapping from frozen exploration_seed and phase index

transport: factual native WebRTC video over authenticated localhost TURN/TCP and owned UDP queue
